title: Palavox beginner-speech eval-set manifest
description: Data contract for the beginner-L2 / child WER eval set (plan 11 §5.2). Every clip MUST carry a consent record (plan 11 §5.3) — a manifest without consent fields is invalid and the harness refuses to run it. Audio files themselves are never committed to the repo; they live in private storage and are referenced by relative path.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump on breaking changes; scoring runs record it for reproducibility (plan 11 §5.2 'Reproducibility').

id.description: Unique clip id within the manifest.

path.description: Audio file path relative to the manifest file. Audio stays in private storage — never committed.

l1.description: Speaker's first language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'es', 'es-MX', 'gu', 'ko', 'en'). A speaker is the native-adult baseline for a clip when ageBand='adult' and the primary subtag of l1 equals the clip language (plan 11 §6.4 gate 1 equity bound).

consent.description: REQUIRED consent record per plan 11 §5.3: purpose-limited written consent (benchmarking + provider evaluation only). Manifests without it must fail validation.

obtained.description: Must be literally true. 'false' or absent is a validation error, not a warning.

method.description: How consent was captured, e.g. 'written consent form v1 (benchmark + provider evaluation only)'.

guardianConsent.description: Guardian consent + child assent. REQUIRED (and must be true) when speaker.ageBand='child' (plan 11 §5.2 child-speech rule, §5.3).

normalizedTranscript.description: Optional pre-normalized reference. When present it is the input to the harness's normalization pass instead of 'transcript'.

tags.description: Optional labels, e.g. 'code-switch', 'minimal-pair', 'spontaneous', 'scripted', 'noise-overlay' (composition categories of plan 11 §5.2).
